stage=Path('/workspace/scratch/90465ae04106/r11-release');repo=Path('/workspace/scratch/90465ae04106/hepta-hcsn')

def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def check(path,expected,expected_bytes=None):
 raw=path.read_bytes();actual=sha(raw)
 row=dict(path=str(path),expected_sha256=expected,actual_sha256=actual,bytes=len(raw),passed=actual==expected and (expected_bytes is None or len(raw)==expected_bytes))
 if not row['passed']:raise AssertionError(row)
 return row
out={}
freeze=json.loads((stage/'evidence/training_02/FREEZE.json').read_text())
out['training_02_source']=[check(stage/name,value) for name,value in freeze['source'].items()]

for lane,filename in [('content','DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json'),('numerics','PUBLICATION_MANIFEST.json')]:
 m=json.loads((stage/lane/filename).read_text())
 out[lane+'_publication_manifest']=[check(stage/lane/row['path'],row['sha256'],row['bytes']) for row in m['files']]
for filename in ['evidence/BUILD_02.json','propagation/evidence/BUILD_02.json']:
 m=json.loads((stage/filename).read_text());rows=[];vendor=Path(m['binary']).parents[2]/'vendor'
 for name,expected in m['source_sha256'].items():
  if name.startswith('cached-dependency/'):
   stem=name.split('/',1)[1];folder=vendor/stem
   inventory={str(p.relative_to(folder)):sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(folder.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
   actual=sha(json.dumps(inventory,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode())
   row=dict(path=name,resolved=str(folder),kind='cached_source_directory',files=len(inventory),expected_sha256=expected,actual_sha256=actual,passed=actual==expected and inventory==m['dependency_sources'][stem]['source_files'])
   assert row['passed'],row;rows.append(row)
  else:
   path=stage/name[len(prefix):] if name.startswith(prefix) else repo/name
   row=check(path,expected);row.update(recorded_path=name,kind='staging_source' if name.startswith(prefix) else 'repository_base_source');rows.append(row)
 serialization=json.dumps(m['source_sha256'],sort_keys=True) if filename.startswith('propagation/') else json.dumps(m['source_sha256'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
 digest=sha(serialization.encode())
 assert digest==m['source_digest'],filename
 out[filename]=dict(rows=rows,source_digest=digest,all_match=True)
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
